# Compact-senses fixtures

`offline_es_touch.html` is the exact 825-byte HTML payload for `touch` from the installed `es-20261018/es-es.dict.dz`, extracted on 2026-11-15 at index 114157, uncompressed offset 127830621. The raw payload includes the `Rugby` and nested `Uso: coloquial` labels; the existing extraction omits those labels. Tests assert the existing displayed definition strings, not reconstructed source content.

Boundary examples in `spanish_boundaries.html` are synthetic and do not claim to reproduce a live dictionary entry.
